source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
These are roughly 200 papers I think are relevant for the TI. Most of them are from 2018-2020; it becomes more sparse 2020-2023. I've recently moved to a local AGPLv3 PostgresQL-hooked up RSS reader and I don't know how to import these bookmarked papers as a category. So, I figured I'd release them if anyone more tech savvy wanted to do anything with them. Graham (talk) 23:53, 15 July 2025 (UTC)
